title: Moby-Dick; or, The Whale
summary: A tale of obsession and revenge aboard the whaling ship Pequod, led by Captain Ahab who is determined to hunt down the white sperm whale Moby Dick that maimed him. Through a series of adventures at sea, narrator Ishmael recounts the voyage, encounters with diverse crew members like harpooneer Queequeg, and escalating supernatural dread as Ahab’s monomaniacal quest leads to tragedy.
